other: {st:ChargeNoirAlly} is her Unique Charge and is produced and consumed (if she has enough) by all her skills. Her passive gives her +1 Coin Power at 3+ potency and bonus damage per count. The passive also gives her +1 Coin Power when the target has 6+ {st:Vibration}.
usage: Swaps between {st:NoirSuitAlly} and {st:RealisationAlly} as a build-up and payoff phase. She starts with 25 {st:NoirSuitAlly} and gains it whenever she gains or consumes her Unique Charge {st:ChargeNoirAlly} or gets hit with a shield. At 100 stacks, it transforms into {st:RealisationAlly} which is consumed to give her skills additional power and damage and upgrades her S3 to {skill:10416|05}. Once it hits 0 stacks, it transforms back to {st:NoirSuitAlly} to start building up again.
Passively gains shields every turn based on {st:NoirSuitAlly} and {st:RealisationAlly}.

1041601.desc:
When triggering [VibrationExplosion] on the enemy, increase the Stagger Threshold raise by +15%
- At 12+ [ChargeNoirAlly] Count, consume 1 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count when triggering [VibrationExplosion] to increase the Stagger Threshold raise by +30% instead (effect applied per target)

When hit, if this unit has Shield, inflict 2 [Vibration] Potency on the attacker (2 times per turn per enemy)
1041601.name: Feedback

1041602.desc:
Upon entering the field, gain 25 [NoirSuitAlly]

Turn Start: Gain Shield equal to (([NoirSuitAlly] + [RealisationAlly]) / 5)% of this unit's max HP
1041602.name: Le Noir: Gabardine Fabric

1041603.desc:
Upon entering the field, gain 25 [NoirSuitAlly]

Turn Start:
- Gain Shield equal to (([NoirSuitAlly] + [RealisationAlly]) / 5)% of this unit's max HP
- If this unit has [RealisationAlly], convert "Triple Stamped Stitching" into "Single Kick - Couture Multiple"
1041603.name: Le Noir: Gabardine Fabric

1041604.desc:
Gain 1 [ChargeNoirAlly] Potency for every 10 cumulative [ChargeNoirAlly] Count this unit consumes in this Encounter

Turn End: At fewer than 3 [ChargeNoirAlly] Potency, consume all [ChargeNoirAlly] Count to gain ([ChargeNoirAlly] Count consumed x 5) Shield next turn

At 3+ [ChargeNoirAlly] Potency, this unit's Base Skills gain +1 more [ChargeNoirAlly] Count when this unit has fewer than 12 [ChargeNoirAlly] Count

On Base Attack Skill Use,
- If target has 6+ [Vibration] Potency, Coin Power +1
- At 3+ [ChargeNoirAlly] Potency, Coin Power +1
- Deal +([ChargeNoirAlly] Potency x 2)% damage (max 10%)
· If the said Skill is "Triple Stamped Stitching" or "Single Kick - Couture Multiple", deal +([ChargeNoirAlly] Potency x 4)% damage instead (max 20%)
1041604.name: Conservation

1041621.desc: Among allies that have [Charge] or Unique [Charge], when 1 ally with the earliest Deployment Order triggers [VibrationExplosion] using its Base Skills, increase the Stagger Threshold raise by +12.5%
1041621.name: Le Noir's Virtue and Worth
